chapters.title: Support information across all feedback channels

features.name: In-product feedback mechanism
features.description: Users can provide positive feedback, suggestions, and issue reports directly within the Expense Agent product interface.

features.name: Contextual expense feedback
features.description: Users can provide specific feedback about expenses they run into, indicating what worked well or what did not work well.

features.name: Screenshot capture with redaction
features.description: Users can capture and include screenshots with feedback, with the ability to hide personal information and highlight important details.

features.name: Support information collection
features.description: Automatic collection and provision of support information alongside feedback from any channel in the product, enabling follow-up with users.

features.name: Optional contact information
features.description: Users can optionally provide contact information to be reached regarding their feedback, though feedback is tracked regardless.
